svg.text: Rip 50 x 100 hardwood; plane top and bottom to the flare angle

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: so the section is a 50 x 82 parallelogram, 70 high.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill 9 mm clearance square to the inboard face at every

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: frame it crosses, 45 below the top edge measured up the face.

svg.text: Fits: flat face on the frame faces, top edge on the gauge mark;

svg.text: one M8 x 100 coach screw into each frame (5.5 pilot, 50 deep).
